messages:
Elaine: opened a short PR to tighten SOC2 / audit-export wording and add a tiny SDK migration note for older clients. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012
Marcus: nice. legal asked to avoid hard deletion promises. recommend: 'retained consistent with our documented retention policy and applicable law.'
Jin: tech note: a few legacy SDKs used `retention_days` (int). new SDKs accept `retention_policy` (string labels like 'audit:90d'). i'll add Ruby + Go snippets for variety.
Legal: add cross-ref to SOC2 FAQ and a short caveat: 'exports and retention may be subject to legal holds or regulatory obligations.' keep redaction language high-level.
Elaine: will update wording and add migration section + a troubleshooting bullet. also adding a CI smoke-test checkbox for snippets.
Jin: Ruby example (new SDK):
```
require 'redwood'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.audit.export(tenant_id: 'acct-a1', retention_policy: 'audit:90d', redacted: true)
puts resp.url
```

Go example (legacy vs new):
```
// legacy
resp, _ := client.Audit.Export(ctx, &AuditExportParams{TenantID: "acct-a1", RetentionDays: 90})
// new
resp, _ := client.Audit.Export(ctx, &AuditExportParams{TenantID: "acct-a1", RetentionPolicy: "audit:90d", Redacted: true})
fmt.Println(resp.URL)
```
Marcus: tiny wording tweak: use 'exports with redaction applied' instead of 'redacted exports' in public copy.
Elaine: updated. added legal caveat + SOC2 FAQ link and removed any infra specifics.
Jin: added troubleshooting note: if export URL returns 403, check tenant export permissions and whether requested retention is allowed by tenant policy. also noted servers may reject deprecated params in strict-mode.
docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/1012/export-phrasing-and-sdk-migration preview expires in 7 days. :rocket:
Legal: quick pass complete, wording looks good; will do final sign-off after CI smoke tests run.
Elaine: thanks all  will merge after legal signs off and snippets pass CI.
